name: Wix
summary: Website builder, host and ICANN-accredited registrar, with an AI site generator (Harmony) the vendor says builds a full mobile-friendly site from a chat, and Symphony, an agent platform it says runs the business. Two MCP surfaces: the Wix MCP at mcp.wix.com/mcp for the owner's agent, measured 401 keyless and documented as needing a Wix account; and a built-in, keyless MCP server on every Wix site for visitors' agents, measured 200 on one live site with ten tools, three of which the vendor's page does not list. Sites run only on Wix's servers; the domain can leave.
license: Hosted under Wix's Terms of Use

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-22: initialize, a sessionless tools/list and a GET at mcp.wix.com/mcp each 401, one 79-byte body. A Wix SITE's own /_api/mcp answered a keyless POST 200 with 10 tools (39,058 B, same count as 10-17) and the same URL answered a keyless GET 401, so the method decides.

payments.notes: Read 2026-10-17: the plans page names Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB and Diners, says 'Displayed prices are for yearly subscriptions, paid in full at the time of purchase'; free plan 'No credit card required'. Renewal terms sit in a client-rendered page not captured. No 402 seen.

jobs.summary: Vendor's words only: the AI builder 'generates a full mobile-friendly site from a chat — pages, layout, text, images'; a custom domain needs a paid plan; hosting is Wix-only ('your site must run on Wix’s servers'), 'the content you build on Wix belongs to you'; the domain can leave. Not measured.
